title: Marc Andreessen on the State of Film and Hollywood

reader_summary.headline: I think movies play the role of our culture.
reader_summary.overview: I think movies play the role of our culture. They're the art form that is capable of basically containing and expressing and making permanent the most important aspects of the culture, or of a civilization. There were a lot of great films in 2019 and then like just a memory hole of like what great film has come out since then.

thesis: Marc Andreessen argues that movies have historically served as the primary art form for capturing and preserving the most important aspects of culture, a role that has declined since the 1990s. He suggests that while highly entertaining films remain popular, the era where movies functioned as the definitive cultural artifacts comparable to the 'Great American Novel' likely ended around that time.
